item.title: Configuring Extensions
item.description: This section describes how to configure extensions. In addition to configuring an extension during its installation, you can also modify an extension’s configuration on its details page in the Extensions Center. Note Configuration changes are not allowed during installation, upgrade, or uninstallation processes. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform.

item.title: Configuring Cluster Agent
item.description: This section describes how to configure the cluster agent. In addition to configuring the cluster agent during extension installation, you can also modify the cluster agent configuration on the extension details page in the Extensions Center. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles. You have successfully installed an extension configured with a cluster agent.

item.title: Disable an Extension
item.description: This section describes how to disable an extension. After an extension is installed, it is automatically enabled. You can disable an extension on its details page in the Extensions Center. After disabling, you can enable it again to continue using the extension in clusters, workspaces, and projects. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, see Users and Platform Roles.
